name: Muse Ember
archDisplay: Meta's smallest and most efficient Muse model (architecture and size undisclosed), the first trained using Muse Wonder Full; 1M-token context with up to 512K output, text+image+audio+video in
note: Meta's November 9, 2026 small model, available as `muse-ember-1.0` on the Meta Model API and Muse Code (also Google Cloud and Oracle Cloud). Priced at $0.10/$0.50 per Mtok for prompts up to 200K tokens ($0.30/$1.50 above), with cached input at $0.004. The launch post says nothing about weights or a license, so it is recorded as closed and API-only. Meta compares it with Claude Haiku 5.5 and GPT-6 Luna, all at max reasoning. ONLY ONE ROW IS FILED. NOT FILED: the Artificial Analysis-run rows Meta labels -AA (AutomationBench-AA 37.8, FrontierCode 2.0-AA 27.2, GDP.pdf-AA 22.8, Coding Agent Index-AA 46, AA Index 36), per the corpus rule on Meta's AA variants; Meta-internal evaluations (Agents' Last Exam Linux subset 61.6, OSWorld 2.1 69.5 partial / 33.8 binary, PerceptionBench with tools 80.6, Personal Superintelligence Index 46.8); and Meta's own Terminal-Bench 4.0 figure (40.9), which pairs each model with a different harness and is superseded by Vals AI's independent run. That leaves it below the ranking-coverage floor until more independent results appear.

results.notes: Terminal-Bench 4.0, Vals AI independent run (reasoning effort max, Meta provider; ±2.31); #15 of 62 on the Vals board. Meta reports 40.9 in its own mini-swe-agent harness. Vals lists no fallback rate for this run.
